L2@P0: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox under Digital Services
L3@P0: Act*
L4@P0: Brussels, 31 August 2026
L5@P0: Today, the Commission has designated ChatGPT as a Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE), as
L6@P0: well as Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs), under the Digital Services Act
L7@P0: (DSA). These services declared that they reach at least 45 million average monthly users in the EU
L8@P0: and thus meet the threshold for designation.
L9@P0: Following the notification of the designations, these services have four months, i.e. by January 2027,
L10@P0: to comply with the additional DSA obligations for VLOPs and VLOSEs, such as assessing and
L11@P0: mitigating the systemic risks stemming from their service and algorithmic systems related to the
L12@P0: dissemination of illegal content, the negative effects on minors, users' physical and mental well-being,
L13@P0: fundamental rights, electoral processes and public security.
L14@P0: With these designations, the Commission will gain investigative powers to assess the functionalities
L15@P0: behind these services and, where applicable, any related system. The Commission will be competent
L16@P0: to supervise compliance with the DSA, in cooperation with Coimisiún na Meán for ChatGPT, and the
L17@P0: Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) for Reddit and Roblox. These entities serve as the Digital
L18@P0: Services Coordinators respectively for Ireland and for the Netherlands, where the designated services
L19@P0: are established.
L20@P0: ChatGPT is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system that can engage with and respond to users' prompts
L21@P0: and queries, including by searching the web. Hence, ChatGPT is a hybrid service that qualifies as an
L22@P0: online search engine under the DSA.
L23@P0: Reddit is a discussion-based platform that enables users to create, share, and interact with content
L24@P0: within topic-based communities. Roblox is an immersive gaming and creation platform that enables
L25@P0: users to create, publish, and play games developed by other users. As these services enable users to
L26@P0: disseminate third-party content to the public, they qualify as online platforms under the DSA.
L27@P0: Roblox, Reddit and ChatGPT are already subject to the general obligations applicable to online
L28@P0: platforms and search engines under the DSA, respectively.
L29@P0: Background
L30@P0: The Commission has now designated 28 very large online platforms and search engines under the
L31@P0: DSA.
L32@P0: The supervision and enforcement of the DSA is shared between the Commission and Digital Services
L33@P0: Coordinators, which are responsible for the enforcement and supervision of the Digital Services Act in
L34@P0: the Member States.
L35@P0: *Updated on 01/09/2026
L36@P0: IP/26/1772
L37@P0: Quote(s):
L38@P0: "These new designations mean that ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox will now be held to a higher standard of scrutiny and
L39@P0: accountability in the European Union, in line with their large impact on our citizens and society. We continue to watch the digital
L40@P0: landscape closely and will not hesitate to designate any platform that meets the threshold for enhanced supervision under the
L41@P0: Digital Services Act."

L210: Sep 02, 2026

L212: * * *
L213: 
L214: We’re taking another step to unlock clean, affordable energy solutions that strengthen the grid. Through a new collaboration with MN8 Energy and Eos Energy Enterprises, Google is backing an innovative, multi-technology clean energy project on the PJM grid.
L215: The project will increase the amount of round-the-clock clean power available to power local digital infrastructure, including a planned Google facility in West Virginia. It will do so by pairing utility-scale solar with both short-duration lithium-ion batteries and long-duration zinc-hybrid batteries. This project is a first of its kind deployment of these zinc-hybrid batteries, manufactured by Eos in Pennsylvania.
L216: The collaboration establishes a new model for how proven and emerging technologies can be deployed together to strengthen the grid.
L217: Read our cite54†press release†mn8.com for more information.

L4: 
L5: cite1†Press Releases L6: 
L7: Sep 2, 2026 | 4 min read
L8: 
L9: cite2†Image: MN8 Energy, Google, and Eos Energy Enterprises Bring Advanced Clean Energy Solutions to West Virginia L10: 
L11: The collaboration pairs utility-scale solar with lithium-ion energy storage and American-made, zinc-based long-duration energy storage to deliver new clean energy and capacity to the PJM grid
L12: This announcement originally appeared on cite3†BusinessWire†www.businesswire.com .
L13: NEW YORK, NY, PITTSBURGH, PA — September 2, 2026 —  cite4†MN8 Energy (MN8 ), a scaled power platform, cite5†Eos Energy Enterprises (NASDAQ: EOSE) (Eos)†www.eose.com , a U.S. manufacturer of zinc-based long-duration energy storage systems, and cite6†Google†about.google , today announced a collaboration to deliver new, clean, around-the-clock energy resources to the PJM grid in support of growing demand in the region.
L14: Owned and operated by MN8, the project combines 86 MW of utility-scale solar, 10 MW/100 MWh of Eos’ Z3™ zinc-based long-duration energy storage, and 70 MW/280 MWh of lithium-ion energy storage. The integrated portfolio adds new clean, dispatchable capacity to the grid serving Google’s data centers in the region, including a planned project in West Virginia.
L15: The solar project is expected to reach commercial operation in 2028, with lithium-ion storage and long-duration storage following in 2029 and 2030, respectively.
L16: An Innovative Capacity Solution
L17: 
L18: MN8 custom-designed its Mammoth Solar project in Kanawha County, West Virginia as an integrated utility-scale solar system with short- and long-duration storage that converts intermittent renewable generation into a single, dispatchable resource. The multi-technology solution fills a critical grid need by delivering clean capacity matched to data center load profiles. It’s the first commercial-scale long-duration energy storage deployment in West Virginia.
L19: “At Google, we’re committed to backing solutions that both serve our data center capacity needs and accelerate progress toward cleaner, more affordable energy systems,” said Lucia Tian, Director, Advanced Energy Technologies at Google. “This collaboration with MN8 and Eos aims to deploy a smart portfolio of round-the-clock technology solutions to help power our digital infrastructure, while creating meaningful economic benefits for West Virginia.”
L20: Under the agreement, Google will purchase the energy, capacity, and clean energy attributes of the project, advancing the company’s cite7†commitment†blog.google to bring new capacity to the grids where it operates.
L21: The project is part of Google’s broader efforts to accelerate LDES technology commercialization with the aim to rapidly bring its potential to communities everywhere — making reliable, affordable electricity available around the clock and supporting the resilience of grids as they integrate growing amounts of renewable energy sources.
L22: “This project reflects what MN8 does best: understanding a customer’s unique energy profile and building a solution around it,” said Jon Yoder, President and CEO of MN8 Energy. “Because Google was willing to pair next-generation storage with utility-scale solar, we could engineer proven and emerging technologies into one dispatchable resource – and deliver clean, around-the-clock power where the grid needs it most.”
L23: 
L24: Deploying American-made Long-Duration Energy Storage
L25: The project marks Google’s first project that uses Eos’ American-made Z3 technology and the first project under the previously cite8†announced†investors.eose.com MN8-Eos Master Supply Agreement. The 10 MW/100 MWh system is designed to provide 10 hours of storage, extending the availability of solar generation beyond the shorter-duration energy storage resources and enabling the combined portfolio to deliver dependable capacity across more hours of the day.
L26: This project will prove how Eos’ aqueous zinc chemistry can support critical grid infrastructure.
L27: “The grid needs more from every megawatt of new generation,” said Nathan Kroeker, Chief Commercial Officer at Eos. “Our work with Google is focused on deploying American-made long-duration storage where it solves real grid reliability challenges. Z3 extends the value of clean generation across more hours, strengthens the overall portfolio, and delivers more dependable capacity when it’s needed most.”
L28: 
L29: Creating Economic Benefits in West Virginia and Across the Region
L30: Built on a reclaimed coal mine in West Virginia, this project is expected to create economic opportunity in a community with a long energy history. Based on MN8’s estimates, it represents up to $350 million in capital investment and is expected to generate approximately $4 million in property tax revenue for the county and local schools over the first 20 years of operations, with millions more in the 15-20 years that follow.
L31: Construction is expected to create approximately 200 jobs, with additional full- and part-time roles supporting the project throughout its operating life.
L32: The project’s impact also extends across the PJM interconnection, connecting new energy infrastructure in West Virginia with American manufacturing and regional innovation. MN8 and Eos maintain significant operations and workforces across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, from MN8 projects spanning the region to Eos headquarters and manufacturing in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Together, the companies support domestic supply chains and regional economies.
L33: 
L34: About MN8
L35: MN8 is a scaled power platform that develops, owns and operates energy assets for the enterprises driving the new American economy. We help customers secure scaled power to support growth, resiliency and long-term energy goals.
L36: With more than 4 gigawatts of operating and under-construction assets across 29 states, MN8 is one of the largest independent power producers in the United States, serving more than 200 customers — including leading AI and hyperscale technology companies, Fortune 500 corporations and government agencies. Our integrated platform spans utility-scale solar, battery storage, EV and electrification infrastructure, and powered land capabilities.
L37: Founded within Goldman Sachs and operating independently since 2022, MN8 pairs institutional-grade financial discipline with full-lifecycle execution capabilities. MN8 is headquartered in New York, with offices in South Florida, Dallas and Madrid, Spain. Learn more at mn8.com.
L38: About Eos Energy Enterprises
L39: Eos is accelerating the shift to American energy independence with positively ingenious solutions that transform how the world stores power. The Company’s BESS features the innovative Znyth™ technology, a proven chemistry with readily available non-precious earth components, that is the pre-eminent safe, non-flammable, secure, stable, and scalable alternative to conventional technology.
L40: The Company’s BESS is ideal for utility-scale, microgrid, commercial, and industrial long-duration energy storage applications (i.e., 4 to 16+ hours) and provides customers with significant operational flexibility to cost effectively address current and future increased grid demand and complexity. For more information about Eos (NASDAQ: EOSE), visit eose.com.
L41: About Google
L42: 
L43: Google’s mission is to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. Through products and platforms like Search, Maps, Gmail, Android, Google Play, Google Cloud, Chrome and YouTube, Google plays a meaningful role in the daily lives of billions of people and has become one of the most widely-known companies in the world. Google is a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.
